blocks.value: An Initial Public Offering (IPO) is the first time a private company offers its shares to the public through a stock exchange.
Imagine This: A successful family-owned bakery wants to open stores across India. Instead of borrowing all the money from banks, it invites the public to become part owners by buying shares.
Many well-known Indian companies became publicly listed through an IPO before their shares started trading on NSE and BSE.
Buying an IPO doesn't automatically mean you'll make profits. Research is just as important.
